review.scope: Scripted worker and explicit host acknowledgment/selection boundaries; not an implemented pool, journal or GPU controller.

cases.name: existing_target_zero_quota_commit
cases.derivation: Scalar F2 multiplication already reaches target1. Starting preflight consumes no worker or host RNG. Failed acknowledgments cannot certify target; successful commitment records existing evidence with no new identity.

cases.name: selected_restart_target_keeps_host_draw
cases.derivation: Explicit isolated restart request. Seed7 MT19937-64 selects the sole known parent with one draw. Target preflight retains that host draw and worker initial countdown but consumes no installation draw/control credit.

cases.name: mandatory_zero_quota_restart_and_budget
cases.derivation: F2 scalar1+1+1=1 reduces to one term after three flip words. q0 still draws; naive ceiling1 blocks both expansion events. Empty flip recovery requests restart. No host selection precedes mandatory commitment. A single parent draw and installation consume continuing streams and the final control credit. Rank1 mandatory evidence and its historical identity survive; repeated commitment has no discovery credit.

cases.name: full_quota_then_lower_discovery_weighted_restart
cases.derivation: Scripted valid F2 states isolate capture behavior. Two rank5 encounters fill then overflow optional quota; rank3 replaces mandatory evidence outside that quota. Blocked recovery requests restart. Seed7 weighted choice must select the second rank5 parent; its zero terms remain live. Mandatory rank3 evidence survives, with exactly one new canonical identity across both commits.
